# Hide API (full text)

> Hide (Heaps IDE) is the editor of the Heaps engine. `hrt` is its runtime, used by the games: prefabs (3D levels, FX, materials, render props...), shader graphs, animation graphs and texture graphs. `hide` is the editor itself (JS/nw.js and HashLink versions): views, property editors, CastleDB editor and editing tools of the prefabs.

# hrt.animgraph.AnimGraph

**class** · package [`hrt.animgraph`](README.md) · source [`hrt/animgraph/AnimGraph.hx`](https://github.com/Jonathan-HETEAU/hide/blob/ccr-01f70725-tatboj/hrt/animgraph/AnimGraph.hx)

Extends: [`hrt.prefab.Prefab`](../prefab/Prefab.md)

An animation graph made with nodes in the editor (`.animgraph` file): blends animations depending on parameters. Play it with `getAnimation`.

## Constructor

### new

```haxe
function new(parent:hrt.prefab.Prefab, contextShared:hrt.prefab.ContextShared):Void
```

## Static variables

### customResolverProvider

```haxe
static var customResolverProvider:(graph:AnimGraph) -> AnimResolver
```

Called by getAnimation when the given resolver is null. Allow the game to provide a custom animation resolver on a prefab by prefab basis.

### customAnimNameLister _(editor (js) only)_

```haxe
static var customAnimNameLister:(context:EditorProviderContext) -> Array<String>
```

Used to display a list of valid animation names to use with the animResolver feature

### customEditorResolverProvider _(editor (js) only)_

```haxe
static var customEditorResolverProvider:(context:EditorProviderContext) -> Array<{ resolver:AnimResolver, name:String }>
```

Return a list of resolvers to use in the editor to preview various configurations.
name is the string that will be displayed in the Anim Set selection box in the editor

## Static methods

### getSerializablePropsStatic

```haxe
static function getSerializablePropsStatic():Array<hrt.prefab.PrefabField>
```

Returns the list of props that have the @:s meta tag associated to them in this prefab type

## Methods

### getAnimation

```haxe
function getAnimation(?previewNode:hrt.animgraph.nodes.AnimNode, ?modelCache:h3d.prim.ModelCache, ?resolver:Null<AnimResolver>):AnimGraphInstance
```

Get the animation "template" for this AnimGraph.
This anim should be instanciated using getInstance() after that (or use the h3d.scene.Object.playAnimation() function that does this for you)

### getNodeByEditorId _(editor (js) only)_

```haxe
function getNodeByEditorId(id:Int):Node
```

Returns the node of an editor id (editor only).

### make

```haxe
override function make(?sh:hrt.prefab.ContextMake):AnimGraph
```

Instanciates this prefab. If `sh` is given or if `this.shared.isInstance` is false, this prefab is cloned and the clone is instanciated and returned. If `this.shared.isInstance` is true, this prefab is instanciated instead.

## Methods

### tick

```haxe
function tick(dt:Float):Void
```

Called by the animgraph once per frame. The @:inputs you declared in your
class will be the one you need to use to update your @:outputs variables.
This function should be "pure" in a sense that the state of the @:outputs
should only depends on the state of your @:inputs, and not some other global
state

### resetSmoothedValues

```haxe
function resetSmoothedValues():Void
```

Called on the node when AnimGraphInstance.resetSmoothedValues is called
Should reset all the smoothed parameters to their input value OR default values

### serializeToDynamic

```haxe
function serializeToDynamic():Dynamic
```

Returns the serialized node, with the values of its unconnected float inputs.

### getInputs

```haxe
function getInputs():Array<NodeInputInfo>
```

### getOutputs

```haxe
function getOutputs():Array<NodeOutputInfo>
```

# hrt.impl.Color

**class** · package [`hrt.impl`](README.md) · module [`hrt.impl.ColorSpace`](ColorSpace.md) · source [`hrt/impl/ColorSpace.hx`](https://github.com/Jonathan-HETEAU/hide/blob/ccr-01f70725-tatboj/hrt/impl/ColorSpace.hx)

A color with 8 bits components.

## Constructor

### new

```haxe
inline function new(?r:Int = 0, ?g:Int = 0, ?b:Int = 0, ?a:Int = 0):Void
```

Creates a color.

## Static methods

### fromInt

```haxe
static inline function fromInt(rgb:Int, ?withAlpha:Bool = true):Color
```

Returns the color of an RGB or ARGB integer (alpha `255` without alpha).

### intFromString

```haxe
static function intFromString(str:String, withAlpha:Bool):Null<Int>
```

Returns the color of a hexadecimal string (`#` optional): `GG` gray, `RGB`, `RRGGBB` or `AARRGGBB`, or `null` if invalid. The alpha is set to `0xFF` or removed according to `withAlpha`.

## Variables

### r

```haxe
var r:Int
```

The red component, from `0` to `255`.

### g

```haxe
var g:Int
```

The green component, from `0` to `255`.

### b

```haxe
var b:Int
```

The blue component, from `0` to `255`.

### a

```haxe
var a:Int
```

The alpha component, from `0` to `255`.

## Methods

### load

```haxe
function load(rgb:Int, ?withAlpha:Bool = true):Void
```

Sets the components from an RGB or ARGB integer (alpha `255` without alpha).

### toInt

```haxe
inline function toInt(includeAlpha:Bool):Int
```

Returns the color as an RGB or ARGB integer.

---

# hrt.impl.ColorSpace

**class** · package [`hrt.impl`](README.md) · source [`hrt/impl/ColorSpace.hx`](https://github.com/Jonathan-HETEAU/hide/blob/ccr-01f70725-tatboj/hrt/impl/ColorSpace.hx)

Conversions between 8 bits RGB colors (`iRGB`) and other color spaces, stored in [`h3d.Vector4`](../../../heaps/h3d/Vector4.md).

## Static variables

### colorModes

```haxe
static var colorModes:Array<ColorMode>
```

The color spaces: RGB, HSV, HSL, XYZ, LAB and HCL.

## Static methods

### iRGBtofRGB

```haxe
static function iRGBtofRGB(color:Color, outVector:h3d.Vector4):h3d.Vector4
```

Returns the color as floats from `0` to `1`.

### fRGBtoiRGB

```haxe
static function fRGBtoiRGB(color:h3d.Vector4, outColor:Color):Color
```

Sets `outColor` (created if `null`) to the color of floats from `0` to `1`, and returns it.

### iRGBtoHSV

```haxe
static function iRGBtoHSV(color:Color, ?outVector:h3d.Vector4):h3d.Vector4
```

Returns the color in HSV (hue, saturation, value and alpha, from `0` to `1`).

### HSVtoiRGB

```haxe
static function HSVtoiRGB(hsv:h3d.Vector4, outColor:Color):Color
```

Sets `outColor` (created if `null`) to the color of a value in HSV (hue, saturation, value and alpha, from `0` to `1`), and returns it.

### iRGBtoHSL

```haxe
static function iRGBtoHSL(color:Color, ?outVector:h3d.Vector4):h3d.Vector4
```

Returns the color in HSL (hue, saturation, lightness and alpha, from `0` to `1`).

### HSLtoiRGB

```haxe
static function HSLtoiRGB(hsl:h3d.Vector4, outColor:Color):Color
```

Sets `outColor` (created if `null`) to the color of a value in HSL (hue, saturation, lightness and alpha, from `0` to `1`), and returns it.

### iRGBtoXYZ

```haxe
static function iRGBtoXYZ(color:Color, ?outVector:h3d.Vector4):h3d.Vector4
```

Returns the color in CIE XYZ.

### XYZtoiRGB

```haxe
static function XYZtoiRGB(value:h3d.Vector4, outColor:Color):Color
```

Sets `outColor` (created if `null`) to the color of a value in CIE XYZ, and returns it.

### LABtoiRGB

```haxe
static function LABtoiRGB(value:h3d.Vector4, outColor:Color):Color
```

Sets `outColor` (created if `null`) to the color of a value in CIE L*a*b*, and returns it.

### iRGBtoLAB

```haxe
static function iRGBtoLAB(color:Color, ?outVector:h3d.Vector4):h3d.Vector4
```

Returns the color in CIE L*a*b*.

### iRGBtoHCL

```haxe
static function iRGBtoHCL(color:Color, ?outVector:h3d.Vector4):h3d.Vector4
```

Returns the color in HCL (hue, chroma, luminance).

### HCLtoiRGB

```haxe
static function HCLtoiRGB(value:h3d.Vector4, outColor:Color):Color
```

Sets `outColor` (created if `null`) to the color of a value in HCL (hue, chroma, luminance), and returns it.

# hrt.impl.RemoteConsole

**class** · package [`hrt.impl`](README.md) · source [`hrt/impl/RemoteConsole.hx`](https://github.com/Jonathan-HETEAU/hide/blob/ccr-01f70725-tatboj/hrt/impl/RemoteConsole.hx)

A simple socket-based local communication channel (plaintext and unsafe),
aim at communicate between 2 programs (e.g. Hide and a HL game).

Usage in game (see also hrt.impl.RemoteTools):
```haxe
var rcmd = new hrt.impl.RemoteConsole();
// rcmd.log = (msg) -> logToUI(msg);
// rcmd.logError = (msg) -> logErrorToUI(msg);
rcmd.connect();
rcmd.sendCommand("log", "Hello!", function(r) {});
```

## Constructor

### new

```haxe
function new(?port:Int, ?host:String):Void
```

Creates the console.

## Static variables

### DEFAULT_HOST

```haxe

```

### DEFAULT_PORT

```haxe
static var DEFAULT_PORT:Int
```

The default port.

### SILENT_CONNECT

```haxe
static var SILENT_CONNECT:Bool
```

Does not log the connection attempts and errors.

## Variables

### host

```haxe
var host:String
```

The host.

### port

```haxe
var port:Int
```

The port.

### connections

```haxe
var connections:Array<RemoteConsoleConnection>
```

The connections.

## Methods

### startServer

```haxe
function startServer(?onClient:() -> Void):Void
```

Starts a server (in the editor), calling `onClient` for each client.

### connect

```haxe
function connect(?onConnected:() -> Void):Void
```

Connects to the server (from the game).

### close

```haxe
function close():Void
```

Closes the socket and the connections.

### isConnected

```haxe
function isConnected():Bool
```

Tells if the socket is open.

### onClose

```haxe
dynamic function onClose():Void
```

Called when the console is closed.

### log

```haxe
dynamic function log(msg:String):Void
```

Logs a message. Traces it by default.

### logError

```haxe
dynamic function logError(msg:String):Void
```

Logs an error. Traces it by default.

### sendCommand

```haxe
function sendCommand(cmd:String, ?args:Dynamic, ?onResult:() -> Void):Void
```

Sends a command to the connections, calling `onResult` with the reply.

# hrt.impl.RemoteConsoleConnection

**class** · package [`hrt.impl`](README.md) · module [`hrt.impl.RemoteConsole`](RemoteConsole.md) · source [`hrt/impl/RemoteConsole.hx`](https://github.com/Jonathan-HETEAU/hide/blob/ccr-01f70725-tatboj/hrt/impl/RemoteConsole.hx)

A connection of a `RemoteConsole`. Messages are JSON lines; the `@cmd` methods are the commands it handles.





## Methods

### close

```haxe

```

### isConnected

```haxe
function isConnected():Bool
```

Tells if the socket is open.

### onClose

```haxe
dynamic function onClose():Void
```

Called when the connection is closed.

### log

```haxe
dynamic function log(msg:String):Void
```

Logs a message. Traces it by default.

### logError

```haxe
dynamic function logError(msg:String):Void
```

Logs an error. Traces it by default.

### sendCommand

```haxe
function sendCommand(cmd:String, ?args:Dynamic, ?onResult:() -> Void):Void
```

Sends a command, calling `onResult` with the reply.

### handleOnData

```haxe
function handleOnData():Void
```

Reads the received messages: replies, or commands to run.

### registerCommand

```haxe
function registerCommand(name:String, f:(args:Dynamic, onDone:() -> Void) -> Void):Void
```

Register a single command `name`, with `f` as command handler.
`args` can be null, or an object that can be parsed from/to json.
`onDone(result)` must be called when `f` finishes, and `result` can be null or a json serializable object.

If `f` is `null`, the command is considered removed.

### registerCommands

```haxe
function registerCommands(o:Dynamic):Void
```

Register functions marked with `@cmd` in instance `o` as command handler (class of `o` needs `@:rtti` and `@:keep`).
This is done with `Reflect` and `registerCommand`, `onDone` call are inserted automatically when necessary.
Function name will be used as `cmd` key (and alias name if `@cmd("aliasname")`),
if multiple function use the same name, only the latest registered is taken into account.

Supported `@cmd` function signature:
``` haxe
@cmd function foo() : Dynamic {}
@cmd function foo(args : Dynamic) : Dynamic {}
@cmd function foo(onDone : Dynamic->Void) : Void {}
@cmd function foo(args : Dynamic, onDone : Dynamic->Void) : Void {}
```

### onConsoleCommand

```haxe
dynamic function onConsoleCommand(cmd:String):Int
```

Runs a console command received from the editor. Logs an error by default.

### onMenuAction

```haxe
dynamic function onMenuAction(action:RemoteMenuAction, id:String):Int
```

Runs a menu entry chosen in the editor. Logs an error by default.

### onUri

```haxe
dynamic function onUri(uri:String):Void
```

Handles a URI received from the editor. Logs an error by default.

# hrt.prefab.CurveBlendMode

**enum abstract** · package [`hrt.prefab`](README.md) · module [`hrt.prefab.Curve`](Curve.md) · source [`hrt/prefab/Curve.hx`](https://github.com/Jonathan-HETEAU/hide/blob/ccr-01f70725-tatboj/hrt/prefab/Curve.hx)

# hrt.prefab.Diff

**class** · package [`hrt.prefab`](README.md) · source [`hrt/prefab/Diff.hx`](https://github.com/Jonathan-HETEAU/hide/blob/ccr-01f70725-tatboj/hrt/prefab/Diff.hx)

Utility class to get the difference between two dynamics

There are two main functions : diff and apply, and they are reciprocal
diff(A,B) = D
apply(A,D) = B

the diff has a special support for prefab if the diffPrefab function is used :
the children array is handled as a special case, and prefabs that change type are
fully serialized in the diff instead of just the delta

Special fields prefixed by an @ can appear in the diff, they are as follow :

@removed : an array of keys name that are present in A but were removed in B
@index : in the prefab children data, indicate that this child has changed index between the A.children and B.children array

The root of a diffPrefab result also contains a `#v` field, set to DIFF_VERSION

## Static variables

### DIFF_VERSION

```haxe
static inline var DIFF_VERSION:Int = 1
```

Version of the diffPrefab format, stored in the `#v` field of the diff root.
Diffs without a version (saved before versioning) are applied with the original apply code,
to reproduce the results they had when they were saved

## Static methods

### addToDiff

```haxe
static function addToDiff(diff:DiffResult, key:String, value:Dynamic):DiffResult
```

Add or Set a key/value pair to a DiffResult. If "diff" was a Skip, it will become a Set({key: value})

### deepCopy

```haxe
static function deepCopy(v:Dynamic):Dynamic
```

Returns a deep copy of a dynamic value.

### diff

```haxe
static function diff(originalValue:Dynamic, modifiedValue:Dynamic):DiffResult
```

Returns the difference of two values together

### diffPrefab

```haxe
static function diffPrefab(original:Dynamic, modified:Dynamic):DiffResult
```

Same as diffObject, but handles `type` and `children` fields as a special case :
children is serialized as an object with prefabName: diffPrefab(prefab)
and if original.type != modified.type, the whole modified object is copied as is
(because we consider that changing the type of a prefab in a diff means the prefab was destroyed then re-created)

### diffObject

```haxe
static function diffObject(original:Dynamic, modified:Dynamic, ?skipFields:Array<String>):DiffResult
```

Returns the difference between two dynamic objects

### diffArray

```haxe
static function diffArray(original:Dynamic, modified:Dynamic):DiffResult
```

Returns the difference between two arrays. If the arrays are found to be different, a full copy of
modified will be returned as a Set()

### apply

```haxe
static function apply(target:Dynamic, diff:Dynamic):Dynamic
```

Modifies `target` dynamic so `apply(a, diffPrefab(a, b)) == b`

`apply` is meant to be used on serialized prefab data, with diffs generated by `diffPrefab`.
Like in diffPrefab, the `children` field of the root and of each prefab in a children diff is handled
with the prefab children diff semantics. Other object fields are merged as generated by diffObject,
including their own `children` fields (for example the `overrides` of a nested Reference).

For performance reasons, `apply` doesn't copy the values it takes from `diff` : objects and arrays
from `diff` are directly referenced in the result, and `diff` itself can be modified during
the process (for example, `@index` fields are consumed). If you need to keep `diff` intact
(e.g. to apply it several times), pass `deepCopy(diff)` instead.

The root of `diff` must contain a `#v` field set to DIFF_VERSION (diffPrefab sets it).
If you craft a diff by hand, add it : a diff without `#v` (or with `#v` == 0) is applied
with the original apply code, which is only kept to load diffs saved before versioning as they were.

---



# hrt.prefab.Prefab

**class** · package [`hrt.prefab`](README.md) · source [`hrt/prefab/Prefab.hx`](https://github.com/Jonathan-HETEAU/hide/blob/ccr-01f70725-tatboj/hrt/prefab/Prefab.hx)

Subclasses: [`hrt.animgraph.AnimGraph`](../animgraph/AnimGraph.md), [`hrt.animgraph.BlendSpace2D`](../animgraph/BlendSpace2D.md), [`hrt.prefab.Curve`](Curve.md), [`hrt.prefab.Material`](Material.md), [`hrt.prefab.MaterialLibrary`](MaterialLibrary.md), [`hrt.prefab.MaterialSelector`](MaterialSelector.md), [`hrt.prefab.Object2D`](Object2D.md), [`hrt.prefab.Object3D`](Object3D.md), [`hrt.prefab.Shader`](Shader.md), [`hrt.prefab.Unknown`](Unknown.md), [`hrt.prefab.fx.Event`](fx/Event.md), [`hrt.prefab.l2d.Blur`](l2d/Blur.md), [`hrt.prefab.l3d.AnimSpeedControl`](l3d/AnimSpeedControl.md), [`hrt.prefab.l3d.Constraint`](l3d/Constraint.md), [`hrt.prefab.l3d.modellibrary.ModelLibrary`](l3d/modellibrary/ModelLibrary.md), [`hrt.prefab.pbr.Anisotropy`](pbr/Anisotropy.md), [`hrt.prefab.pbr.SpecularColor`](pbr/SpecularColor.md), [`hrt.prefab.rfx.RendererFX`](rfx/RendererFX.md), [`hrt.shgraph.ShaderGraph`](../shgraph/ShaderGraph.md), [`hrt.texgraph.TexGraph`](../texgraph/TexGraph.md)

The base class of the prefabs: the serializable nodes of the data edited in Hide (`.prefab`, `.fx`, `.l3d`... files).
A prefab is a tree of prefabs: `make()` instanciates it (creating its 2D/3D objects, see `Object3D` and `Object2D`).

The `@:s` fields are serialized (see [`hrt.prefab.Macros`](Macros.md)). A prefab type is registered with
`public static var _ = Prefab.register("name", MyPrefab);`. Load prefab files with [`hxd.Res`](../../../heaps/hxd/Res.md) (see `Resource`).

## Constructor

### new

```haxe
function new(parent:Prefab, contextShared:ContextShared):Void
```

Creates a prefab, child of `parent`, or root with the given shared context (or a new one).

## Static variables

```haxe

```


### getSerializablePropsStatic

### clone

```haxe
function clone(?parent:Prefab, ?sh:Null<ContextShared>, ?withChildren:Bool = true):Prefab
```

Create a copy of the data this prefab and all of its children (unless `withChildren` is `false`), without calling `make()` on them.
If `parent` is given, then `sh` will be set to `parent.shared`. If `parent` and `sh` is null, `sh` will be set to a new context shared will be created.
The `parent` and `sh` are then given to the clone constructor.

## Methods

### editorInit _(editor (js) only)_

```haxe
function editorInit(source:String):Void
```

Set the source of a newly created reference and load its refInstance.
Must only be used when creating a Reference, not to modify it after the fact : changes
to an existing reference source must go through the inspector so they can be undone.
Throws if the refInstance is already loaded.

### resolve

```haxe
function resolve():Prefab
```

Try to resolve refInstance if it's not loaded.
Loads the prefab referenced by `source`, apply overrides to it if applicable and store it in refInstance and returns it.
If the prefab load process fails, refInstance is null

### editorSyncSourceAction _(editor (js) only)_

```haxe
function editorSyncSourceAction(sourceInstance:Prefab):(isUndo:Bool) -> Void
```

Returns an undo action that replaces the refInstance with a copy of `sourceInstance`, the edited content of
the same source file (from another reference in Edit mode). In Override mode, the overrides of this reference are kept.
Must be recorded in an undo/redo step.

# hrt.prefab.fx.EmitType

When the particles are emitted.

## Constructors

### Infinity

```haxe
Infinity
```

Continuously, at `emitRate` particles per second.

### InfinityRandom

```haxe
InfinityRandom
```

Continuously, at a rate changing randomly between `emitRateMin` and `emitRateMax` every `emitRateChangeDelay` seconds.

### Duration

```haxe
Duration
```

At `emitRate` particles per second during `emitDuration` seconds.

### Burst

```haxe
Burst
```

`burstCount` bursts of `burstParticleCount` particles, every `burstDelay` seconds.

### BurstDuration

```haxe
BurstDuration
```

Bursts of `burstParticleCount` particles every `burstDelay` seconds, during `emitDuration` seconds.

```haxe

```

```haxe

```


### setTime

```haxe

```

Prefer using seek or update depending on the context

### setTimeInternal

```haxe
function setTimeInternal(newTimeParent:Float, dt:Float, isSeek:Bool, ?fullSync:Bool = true):Void
```

newTime is the new time to set, relative to the "parent" timeline
dt is the relative delta of time since the last "parent" update
Depending on how the parent loops, `newTime != lastTime + dt`, that's why the two arguments exists

```haxe

```

# hrt.prefab.fx.Value

**enum** · package [`hrt.prefab.fx`](README.md) · source [`hrt/prefab/fx/Value.hx`](https://github.com/Jonathan-HETEAU/hide/blob/ccr-01f70725-tatboj/hrt/prefab/fx/Value.hx)

An animated value of an FX: constant, curve, random, or combination. Below, `random(rid)` is the random value `rid` of the particle, between `-1` and `1`.

## Constructors

### VZero

```haxe
VZero
```

Zero.

### VConst

```haxe
VConst(v:Float)
```

A constant.

### VCurve

```haxe
VCurve(c:hrt.prefab.Curve)
```

A curve.

### VCurveT

```haxe
VCurveT(c:hrt.prefab.Curve, scale:Float, add:Float)
```

`c * scale + add`.

### VRandom

```haxe
VRandom(rid:Int, scale:Float, add:Float)
```

`random(rid) * scale + add`.

### VRandMultCurve

```haxe
VRandMultCurve(rid:Int, scale:Float, add:Float, c:hrt.prefab.Curve)
```

`(random(rid) * scale + add) * c`.

### VRandAddCurve

```haxe
VRandAddCurve(rid:Int, scale:Float, add:Float, c:hrt.prefab.Curve)
```

`random(rid) * scale + add + c`.

### VBlendCurves

```haxe
VBlendCurves(scale:Float, add:Float, a:hrt.prefab.Curve, b:hrt.prefab.Curve, blendVar:String)
```

`lerp(a, b, blendVar) * scale + add`, blending by the FX parameter `blendVar`.

### VRandomBlendCurves

```haxe
VRandomBlendCurves(rid:Int, scale:Float, add:Float, a:hrt.prefab.Curve, b:hrt.prefab.Curve, blendVar:String)
```

`(random(rid) * scale + add) * lerp(a, b, blendVar)`.

### VRandomBetweenCurves

```haxe
VRandomBetweenCurves(rid:Int, a:hrt.prefab.Curve, b:hrt.prefab.Curve)
```

`lerp(a, b, (random(rid) + 1) / 2)`.

### VParamRemap

```haxe
VParamRemap(a:Value, param:String)
```

`a` evaluated at the value of the FX parameter `param` instead of the time.

### VValueRemap

```haxe
VValueRemap(v:Value, remap:Value)
```

`v` evaluated at the value of `remap` instead of the time.

### VAdd

```haxe
VAdd(a:Value, b:Value)
```

`a + b`.

### VMult

```haxe
VMult(a:Value, b:Value)
```

`a * b`.

### VVector

```haxe
VVector(x:Value, y:Value, z:Value, ?w:Value)
```

A vector (`w` is `1` if `null`).

### VHsl

```haxe
VHsl(h:Value, s:Value, l:Value, a:Value)
```

A color from hue, saturation, lightness and alpha.

# hrt.prefab.l2d.RepeatMode

**enum abstract** · package [`hrt.prefab.l2d`](README.md) · module [`hrt.prefab.l2d.NoiseGenerator`](NoiseGenerator.md) · source [`hrt/prefab/l2d/NoiseGenerator.hx`](https://github.com/Jonathan-HETEAU/hide/blob/ccr-01f70725-tatboj/hrt/prefab/l2d/NoiseGenerator.hx)

The tiling of a `NoiseGenerator` texture.

Underlying type: `String`

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `Both` | `"Both"` | Tiles horizontally and vertically. |
| `X` | `"X"` | Tiles horizontally. |
| `Y` | `"Y"` | Tiles vertically. |
| `None` | `"None"` | Does not tile. |

# hrt.prefab.l3d.DecalMode

**enum abstract** · package [`hrt.prefab.l3d`](README.md) · module [`hrt.prefab.l3d.Decal`](Decal.md) · source [`hrt/prefab/l3d/Decal.hx`](https://github.com/Jonathan-HETEAU/hide/blob/ccr-01f70725-tatboj/hrt/prefab/l3d/Decal.hx)

How a `Decal` is rendered.

Underlying type: `String`

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `Default` | `"Default"` | A PBR decal, modifying the albedo, normal and material of the surfaces. |
| `BeforeTonemapping` | `"BeforeTonemapping"` | A color decal, before the tonemapping. |
| `AfterTonemapping` | `"AfterTonemapping"` | A color decal, after the tonemapping. |
| `Terrain` | `"Terrain"` | A PBR decal on the terrain. |

# hrt.prefab.l3d.HeightMaPTexturePathKind

**enum abstract** · package [`hrt.prefab.l3d`](README.md) · module [`hrt.prefab.l3d.HeightMap`](HeightMap.md) · source [`hrt/prefab/l3d/HeightMap.hx`](https://github.com/Jonathan-HETEAU/hide/blob/ccr-01f70725-tatboj/hrt/prefab/l3d/HeightMap.hx)

The kind of a texture of a `HeightMap`.

Underlying type: `String`

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `Albedo` | `"albedo"` | An albedo texture, blended by the splat maps. |
| `Height` | `"height"` | The height texture. |
| `Normal` | `"normal"` | The normal map (computed from the height if none). |
| `SplatMap` | `"splatmap"` | A splat map, giving the weights of the albedo textures. |

# hrt.prefab.l3d.SplatMode

**enum abstract** · package [`hrt.prefab.l3d`](README.md) · module [`hrt.prefab.l3d.HeightMap`](HeightMap.md) · source [`hrt/prefab/l3d/HeightMap.hx`](https://github.com/Jonathan-HETEAU/hide/blob/ccr-01f70725-tatboj/hrt/prefab/l3d/HeightMap.hx)

How the splat maps give the weights of the albedo textures.

Underlying type: `String`

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `Weights3` | `"Weights3"` | Each splat map gives the weights (RGB) of 3 albedo textures. |
| `Weights4` | `"Weights4"` | Each splat map gives the weights (RGBA) of 4 albedo textures. |
| `BaseWeights3` | `"BaseWeights3"` | Like `Weights3`, over the first albedo texture. |
| `BaseWeights4` | `"BaseWeights4"` | Like `Weights4`, over the first albedo texture. |
| `I1I2W1W2` | `"I1I2W1W2"` | Each splat map gives two albedo indexes (RG) and their weights (BA). |

---

# hrt.prefab.l3d.Spline

**class** · package [`hrt.prefab.l3d`](README.md) · source [`hrt/prefab/l3d/Spline.hx`](https://github.com/Jonathan-HETEAU/hide/blob/ccr-01f70725-tatboj/hrt/prefab/l3d/Spline.hx)

Extends: [`hrt.prefab.Object3D`](../Object3D.md) → [`hrt.prefab.Prefab`](../Prefab.md)

A 3D curve through points, editable in the editor. It is sampled in world space to be evaluated at a progress `t` from `0` to `1`.

```haxe
EStretch
```

Stretched between the head (`u = 0`) and the tail (`u = 1`).

### ETileFixed

```haxe
ETileFixed
```

Tiled along the trail, the texture staying fixed in world space.

### ETileFollow

```haxe
ETileFollow
```

Tiled along the trail, the texture following the head (`u = 0` at the head).

### ELifetime

```haxe
ELifetime
```

The life of the point.

# hrt.prefab.l3d.UVRepeat

**enum** · package [`hrt.prefab.l3d`](README.md) · module [`hrt.prefab.l3d.Trails`](Trails.md) · source [`hrt/prefab/l3d/Trails.hx`](https://github.com/Jonathan-HETEAU/hide/blob/ccr-01f70725-tatboj/hrt/prefab/l3d/Trails.hx)

How the texture coordinate U repeats.

## Constructors

### EMod

```haxe
EMod
```

From `0` to `1`, then back to `0`: for textures tiling horizontally.

### EMirror

```haxe
EMirror
```

From `0` to `1`, then from `1` to `0`: for textures not tiling horizontally.

### EClamp

```haxe
EClamp
```

From `0` to `1`, then stays at `1`.

### ENone

```haxe
ENone
```

No repeat.

# hrt.prefab.pbr.AnisotropyMode

**enum abstract** · package [`hrt.prefab.pbr`](README.md) · module [`hrt.prefab.pbr.Anisotropy`](Anisotropy.md) · source [`hrt/prefab/pbr/Anisotropy.hx`](https://github.com/Jonathan-HETEAU/hide/blob/ccr-01f70725-tatboj/hrt/prefab/pbr/Anisotropy.hx)

Where the anisotropy of an `Anisotropy` comes from.

Underlying type: `String`

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `Flat` | `"Flat"` | A constant intensity and direction. |
| `NoiseTexture` | `"NoiseTexture"` | Intensity and direction textures. |
| `Vertex` | `"Vertex"` | The vertex data. |
| `Frequency` | `"Frequency"` | A constant direction, with a noise on the intensity. |
| `FlowMap` | `"FlowMap"` | A flow map texture giving the direction. |

---

# hrt.prefab.pbr.SpecularColor

**class** · package [`hrt.prefab.pbr`](README.md) · source [`hrt/prefab/pbr/SpecularColor.hx`](https://github.com/Jonathan-HETEAU/hide/blob/ccr-01f70725-tatboj/hrt/prefab/pbr/SpecularColor.hx)

Extends: [`hrt.prefab.Prefab`](../Prefab.md)

Sets the specular color of the materials of its parent `Material`.

## Constructor

### new

```haxe

```

## Static methods

### getSerializablePropsStatic

```haxe

```

Returns the list of props that have the @:s meta tag associated to them in this prefab type

## Variables

### specular

```haxe
var specular:Float
```

The amount of dielectric specular reflection: the facing reflectivity, in the common 0 to 8% range.

### specularTint

```haxe
var specularTint:Float
```

Tints the facing specular reflection with the base color, while the glancing reflection stays white. Not physically correct: fakes materials with a complex surface structure.

### specularColorPath

```haxe
var specularColorPath:String
```

The path of the specular color texture (`Texture` mode).

### specularColorCustomValue

```haxe
var specularColorCustomValue:Int
```

The specular color, as RGB (`Flat` mode).

### mode

```haxe
var mode:SpecularColorMode
```

Where the specular color comes from.

# hrt.prefab.rfx.Pattern

**enum abstract** · package [`hrt.prefab.rfx`](README.md) · module [`hrt.prefab.rfx.FrustumJitter`](FrustumJitter.md) · source [`hrt/prefab/rfx/FrustumJitter.hx`](https://github.com/Jonathan-HETEAU/hide/blob/ccr-01f70725-tatboj/hrt/prefab/rfx/FrustumJitter.hx)

A pattern of sub-pixel offsets of the camera, for temporal anti-aliasing.

Underlying type: `String`

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `Still` | `"Still"` | No jitter. |
| `Uniform2` | `"Uniform2"` | 2 samples on a diagonal. |
| `Uniform4` | `"Uniform4"` | 4 samples on a square. |
| `Uniform4_Helix` | `"Uniform4_Helix"` | 4 samples on a square, in helix order. |
| `Uniform4_DoubleHelix` | `"Uniform4_DoubleHelix"` | 8 samples: the square in helix order, then in a Z order. |
| `SkewButterfly` | `"SkewButterfly"` | 4 samples on two skewed diagonals. |
| `Rotated4` | `"Rotated4"` | 4 samples on a rotated square. |
| `Rotated4_Helix` | `"Rotated4_Helix"` | 4 samples on a rotated square, in helix order. |
| `Rotated4_Helix2` | `"Rotated4_Helix2"` | 4 samples on a rotated square, in another helix order. |
| `Poisson10` | `"Poisson10"` | 10 samples of a Poisson disc distribution. |
| `Pentagram` | `"Pentagram"` | 5 samples on a pentagram. |
| `Halton_2_3_x8` | `"Halton_2_3_x8"` | 8 samples of the Halton (2, 3) sequence. |

# hrt.shgraph.Global

**enum abstract** · package [`hrt.shgraph`](README.md) · module [`hrt.shgraph.Variables`](Variables.md) · source [`hrt/shgraph/Variables.hx`](https://github.com/Jonathan-HETEAU/hide/blob/ccr-01f70725-tatboj/hrt/shgraph/Variables.hx)

A global variable available to the shader graph nodes (see `Variables.Globals`).

Underlying type: `Int`

Implicit casts to: `Int`

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PixelColor` | `0` | `pixelColor`: the color of the pixel. |
| `PixelColorColor` | `1` | The RGB of the pixel color (not in `Variables.Globals`). |
| `PixelColorAlpha` | `2` | The alpha of the pixel color (not in `Variables.Globals`). |
| `Time` | `3` | `global.time`: the time, in seconds. |
| `PixelSize` | `4` | `global.pixelSize`: the size of a pixel. |
| `Global` | `5` | `global`: the global variables. |
| `CalculatedUV` | `6` | `calculatedUV`: the texture coordinates computed by the shaders. |
| `Input` | `7` | `input`: the vertex inputs. |
| `UV` | `8` | `input.uv`: the first texture coordinates. |
| `RelativePosition` | `9` | `relativePosition`: the position in the space of the object. |
| `TransformedPosition` | `10` | `transformedPosition`: the position in world space. |
| `ProjectedPosition` | `11` | `projectedPosition`: the projected position. |
| `Normal` | `12` | `input.normal`: the normal in the space of the object. |
| `FakeNormal` | `13` | `fakeNormal`: the replacement of the normal in the previews. |
| `TransformedNormal` | `14` | `transformedNormal`: the normal in world space. |
| `Depth` | `15` | `depth`: the depth. |
| `Metalness` | `16` | `metalness`: the PBR metalness. |
| `Roughness` | `17` | `roughness`: the PBR roughness. |
| `Emissive` | `18` | `emissive`: the PBR emissive. |
| `Occlusion` | `19` | `occlusion`: the PBR occlusion. |
| `PreviewSelect` | `20` | The parameter selecting the node preview. |
| `PreviewColor` | `21` | `_previewColor`: the color of a node preview. |
| `Camera` | `22` | `camera`: the camera variables. |
| `CameraPosition` | `23` | `camera.position`: the position of the camera. |
| `ParticleLife` | `24` | `particleLife`: the age of the particle. |
| `ParticleLifeTime` | `25` | `particleLifeTime`: the lifetime of the particle. |
| `ParticleRandom` | `26` | `particleRandom`: the random value of the particle. |
| `SGPixelColor` | `27` | `_sg_out_color`: the RGB output of the graph. |
| `SGPixelAlpha` | `28` | `_sg_out_alpha`: the alpha output of the graph. |
| `EmitterPosition` | `29` | `emitterPosition`: the position of the particle emitter. |
| `SourceTexture` | `30` | `global.screenShaderInput`: the input texture of a screen shader graph. |
| `UV2` | `31` | `input.uv2`: the second texture coordinates. |
| `UV3` | `32` | `input.uv3`: the third texture coordinates. |
| `UV4` | `33` | `input.uv4`: the fourth texture coordinates. |

Resolve the type of the dynamic (SgGeneric) inputs/outputs of every node from their connections,
using the same rules as NodeGenContext.initForNode, and store them in
ShaderNode.resolvedInputTypes/resolvedOutputTypes. When nothing is connected to a generic,
it falls back to the most generic type of its constraint if one of its inputs has an inline value,
else its ios are left null (unresolved).

# hrt.shgraph.SgType

**enum** · package [`hrt.shgraph`](README.md) · module [`hrt.shgraph.ShaderGraph`](ShaderGraph.md) · source [`hrt/shgraph/ShaderGraph.hx`](https://github.com/Jonathan-HETEAU/hide/blob/ccr-01f70725-tatboj/hrt/shgraph/ShaderGraph.hx)

The type of an input or output of a shader graph node.

## Constructors

### SgFloat

```haxe
SgFloat(dimension:Int)
```

A float (`dimension` 1) or a vector of `dimension` floats.

### SgSampler

```haxe
SgSampler
```

A texture.

### SgInt

```haxe
SgInt
```

An integer.

### SgBool

```haxe
SgBool
```

A boolean.

### SgGeneric

```haxe
SgGeneric(id:Int, constraint:(newType:hxsl.Type, previousType:hxsl.Type) -> Null<hxsl.Type>)
```

All the generics in the same shader node with the same id unify to the
same type.

Constraint :
    newType : the type we are trying to constraint. If null the function should return previousType
    previousType : the type previously constraint to this generic.
    if both newType and previousType are null, the function should return the most generic type for the constraint
    return : null if the newType can't be constrained, or a type that can fit both new and previous types

# hrt.shgraph.nodes.Reroute

**class** · package [`hrt.shgraph.nodes`](README.md) · source [`hrt/shgraph/nodes/Reroute.hx`](https://github.com/Jonathan-HETEAU/hide/blob/ccr-01f70725-tatboj/hrt/shgraph/nodes/Reroute.hx)

Extends: [`hrt.shgraph.ShaderNode`](../ShaderNode.md)

Subclasses: [`hrt.shgraph.nodes.RerouteBool`](RerouteBool.md), [`hrt.shgraph.nodes.RerouteFloat`](RerouteFloat.md), [`hrt.shgraph.nodes.RerouteInt`](RerouteInt.md), [`hrt.shgraph.nodes.RerouteSampler`](RerouteSampler.md)

Base class for the reroute nodes : forward its input to its output unchanged.
Purely cosmetic, used to tidy up the graph. When the input is not connected,
the output is left null so the nodes downstream behave as if they were not connected either.

The space of the triplanar mapping.

Underlying type: `String`

Implicit casts from: `String`

Implicit casts to: `String`

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `World` | `"World"` | World space. |
| `Local` | `"Local"` | The space of the object. |
| `LocalRotation` | `"LocalRotation"` | World space, rotated with the object. |


Returns the first common root for all classes instances in their class inheritance tree. See getCommonClass for more info

### getCommonClass

```haxe
static function getCommonClass(classes:Array<Class<getCommonClass.T>>, baseClass:Class<getCommonClass.T>):Class<getCommonClass.T>
```

Return the first common root for all classes in their inheritance tree (which should start at baseClass).
For example if B extends A and C extends A, `getCommonClass([B,C], A)` returns A
If D extends B, `getCommonClass([B,D], A)` returns B, and `getCommonClass([C,D], A)` returns A

# hrt.tools.OneToMany

**class** · package [`hrt.tools`](README.md) · source [`hrt/tools/OneToMany.hx`](https://github.com/Jonathan-HETEAU/hide/blob/ccr-01f70725-tatboj/hrt/tools/OneToMany.hx)

Represent a collection of One -> Many relationship, i.e Multiple `Right` elements can point to an unique `Left` element.
For example, a Parent -> Children relationship can be modeled with this, or a Output -> Input in a shadergraph.

## Constructor

### new

```haxe
function new():Void
```

Creates an empty collection.

## Methods

### insert

```haxe
function insert(l:Left, r:Right):Void
```

Add a relation in the collection.
If the right element already has a relation, it will be removed and replaced by this one.

### removeRight

```haxe
function removeRight(r:Right):Null<Left>
```

Removes the relation of a right element. Returns its left element, or `null`.

### removeLeft

```haxe
function removeLeft(l:Left):Void
```

Removes the relations of a left element.

### iterAll

```haxe
function iterAll():KeyValueIterator<Int, Iterator<Right>>
```

Iterates on the left elements and their right elements.

### iterRights

```haxe
function iterRights(l:Left):Iterator<Right>
```

Iterates on the right elements of a left element.

### getLeft

```haxe
function getLeft(r:Right):Null<Left>
```

Returns the left element of a right element, or `null`.

### clear

```haxe
function clear():Void
```

Removes all the relations.

# hrt.tools.Undo

**class** · package [`hrt.tools`](README.md) · source [`hrt/tools/Undo.hx`](https://github.com/Jonathan-HETEAU/hide/blob/ccr-01f70725-tatboj/hrt/tools/Undo.hx)

An undo history of actions.

## Constructor

### new

```haxe
function new():Void
```

Creates an empty history.

## Static methods

### actionFromActions

```haxe
static function actionFromActions(actions:Array<Action>):Action
```

Returns an action applying several actions (reverted in reverse order).

## Methods

### reset

```haxe
function reset():Void
```

Clears the history.

### record

```haxe
function record(action:Action, hasDataChanges:Bool, ?info:Any):Void
```

Record an action that has already been applied. `info` is an optional payload describing the action, passed to onRecord

### onRecord

```haxe
dynamic function onRecord(info:Null<Any>):Void
```

Called once when a new action is recorded (not on undo/redo), before onAfterChange.
mergeWithLast can be called from here to apply the side effects of the recorded action in the same undo step.

### mergeWithLast

```haxe
function mergeWithLast(action:Action):Void
```

Merge `action` into the action that was just recorded : `action` is applied immediately, and is then
undone and redone together with it (redo : recorded action then `action`, undo : `action` then recorded action).
Must only be called from onRecord.

### run

```haxe
function run(action:Action, hasDataChanges:Bool, ?info:Any):Void
```

Applies an action and records it. `hasDataChanges` tells if it modifies the saved data.

### onAfterChange

```haxe
dynamic function onAfterChange():Void
```

Called after each record, undo or redo.

### undo


Each entry can set `globals` (global name to type, `#Type` for the statics of a class or the constructors of an enum, null to remove), `context` or `contexts` (classes whose fields are globals), `publicFields` (only the public methods of the contexts are accessible), `events` (type of the event functions), `evalTo` (expected type of the script value), `allowGlobalsDefine`, `cdbEnums` (CDB sheets available as enums) and `parentScripts` (scripts checked before).

Alias for: `DynamicAccess<{ publicFields:Bool, parentScripts:Array<String>, globals:DynamicAccess<String>, events:String, evalTo:String, contexts:Array<String>, context:String, cdbEnums:Array<String>, allowGlobalsDefine:Null<Bool> }>`

# hide.kit.Element

**class** · package [`hide.kit`](README.md) · source [`hide/kit/Element.hx`](https://github.com/Jonathan-HETEAU/hide/blob/ccr-01f70725-tatboj/hide/kit/Element.hx) · available on editor (js)

Subclasses: [`hide.kit.Block`](Block.md), [`hide.kit.Button`](Button.md), [`hide.kit.CDB`](CDB.md), [`hide.kit.Curve`](Curve.md), [`hide.kit.KitRoot`](KitRoot.md), [`hide.kit.Line`](Line.md), [`hide.kit.Separator`](Separator.md), [`hide.kit.Spacer`](Spacer.md), [`hide.kit.Text`](Text.md), [`hide.kit.Widget`](Widget.md)

An element of the property editor kit (`hide.kit`), built with `ctx.build(<markup/>)` in `Prefab.edit2`.

# hrt.prefab.edit -> hrt.prefab.edit2 Migration notes

- new function signature : edit2(ctx: hrt.prefab.EditContext2).
- must be palced outside a `#if editor` block at the moment
- new element creation syntax (replaces `new hide.Element("...")`):
    ctx.build(<element></element>);
- multiple elements can be build at the same time in a ctx.build by putting them in a unique
    `<root></root>` container. This root container will not appear in the final element tree
    example :
        ctx.build(
            <root>
                <category("A")/>
                <category("B")/>
            </root>
        );
- An optional onChange callback can be passed as the 3rd argument to ctx.build. If set, this function will be bound to all the onValueChange / onClick functions of the widgets in this ctx.build

- `<div class="Group" name="Reference></div>` -> `<category("Reference")></category>`
- `<dl></dl>` -> Nothing (this syntax is not needed anymore)
- `<dt>Label</dt><dd><input type="range" field="x"></input><dd>` -> <slider label="Label" field={x}/>
    Note : if no label is specified, an automatic label will be generated from its field expression if possible, automatically adding caps and spaces if needed (i.e a "fooBar" field creates a "Foo Bar" label)
- Widget conversion suggestions :
    `<input type="button" value="Button Name"/>` -> `<button("Button Name")/>`
        Note : to bind a callback, use the onClick attribute on the button, or add an id to the button and add the callback later
    `<input type="range" min="0" max="360"/>` -> `<range(0, 360)/>`
    `<input type="text">` -> `<input/>`
    `<select></select>` -> `<select(["Choice 1", "Choice 2"])/>`
        Note : the option list can either be a string or an Array<{value: Dynamic, label: String}>. A string array will automatically be converted in a value/label string using the string as the value and the label. The widget `value` will be equal to the `value` of the currently selected item
        Additionally, if the field is an enum, a list of values generated from the enum possible values is generated automatically if you don't supply an option list
    `<input type="texturepath"/>` -> `<file type="texture">` if you don't want to support gratiend (95% of non shader use-cases), otherwise use a `<texture/>`
    `<input type="fileselect" extensions="..."/>` -> `<file type="type_name"/>` The list of allowed type can be found in hide.kit.File.types, you can add more types to the list if needed
    `<p>Info message</p>` -> `<text("Info message")/>`

- Editor api conversions :
    `ctx.rebuildProperties()` -> `ctx.rebuildInspector()`
    `shaded.editor.refreshInteractive(this)` -> `ctx.rebuildPrefab(this)`;
    `shaded.editor.refreshTree(All)` -> `ctx.rebuildTree(this)`;
    `ctx.rebuildPrefab(this)` -> `ctx.rebuildPrefab(this)`;
    `<input title="Tooltip"/>` -> `<element tooltip="Tooltip"/>`
    Callbacks bound in the onChange function should be bound on the relevant widget onValueChange instead

## Constructor


# hide.kit.Slider

**class** · package [`hide.kit`](README.md) · source [`hide/kit/Slider.hx`](https://github.com/Jonathan-HETEAU/hide/blob/ccr-01f70725-tatboj/hide/kit/Slider.hx) · available on editor (js)

Type parameters: `<T>`

Extends: [`hide.kit.Widget`](Widget.md) → [`hide.kit.Element`](Element.md)

Subclasses: [`hide.kit.Range`](Range.md)

A number slider.

## Constructor

### new

```haxe
function new(parent:Element, id:String):Void
```

## Variables

### min

```haxe
var min(default, set):Null<hide.kit.Slider.T>
```

If set, the slider won't go bellow the given value

### max

```haxe
var max(default, set):Null<hide.kit.Slider.T>
```

If set, the slider won't go above the given value

### step

```haxe
var step:Null<hide.kit.Slider.T>
```

Override the default step for editing the curve. Note that if min and max are set the step will be calculated accordingly, but setting
this will override the automatically calculated value.
The step basically control how much each value is rounded each time the slider is moved. Note that at the moment,
values pasted from the clipboard or manually entered by the user using the keyboard are allowed to bypass the step value.

### decimals

```haxe
var decimals:Null<Int>
```

If set, value will be rounded at this number of decimals

### exp

```haxe
var exp:Bool
```

If set, the slider will use an exponential curve (e^x) for editing values.

### poly

```haxe
var poly:Dynamic
```

If set, the slider will use a polynomial curve (x^n) for editing values.
if true, n will be equal to 2, if set to a float, n will be equal to that float instead

### wrap

```haxe
var wrap:Bool
```

If true, when the user reaches the min or max value, the value will wrap to the max / min value respectively

### int

```haxe
var int:Bool
```

If set, the value of this slider will be rounded to the nearest int

### unit

```haxe
var unit:String
```

If set, a unit will be displayed along the value like this "10.0 m/s"

## Inherited members

- from [`hide.kit.Widget`](Widget.md): `label`, `value`, `defaultValue`, `labelColor`, `noUndo`, `onValueChange`, `refreshFields`
- from [`hide.kit.Element`](Element.md): `singleEdit`, `disabled`, `width`, `tooltip`, `id`, `numChildren`, `getChildren`, `make`, `getIdPath`, `getById`, `refreshFields`, `collapse`, `getOrMakeLine`, `buildPropsList`, `buildProp`, `remove`

# hide.tools.DropEvent

**enum** · package [`hide.tools`](README.md) · module [`hide.tools.DragAndDrop`](DragAndDrop.md) · source [`hide_js/hide/tools/DragAndDrop.hx`](https://github.com/Jonathan-HETEAU/hide/blob/ccr-01f70725-tatboj/hide_js/hide/tools/DragAndDrop.hx) · available on editor (js)

An event sent to a drop target.

## Constructors

### Move

```haxe
Move
```

Called when the cursor has moved over a registered drop target

### Enter

```haxe
Enter
```

Called when the cursor stared hovering a registered drop target. Use it to update the style of the drop target to show that
it can receive the drop for example.

### Leave

```haxe
Leave
```

Called when the cursor stopped hovering the previously entered drop target. This event is always called when the drop operation
ends (whenever it has been cancelled or processed). Use it to cleanup any style changes performed in the Move or Enter event for example.

### Drop

```haxe
Drop
```

Called when the users perform a drop action on a registered valid drop target. Not called if a previous onDropEvent set dropTargetValidity to ForbidDrop

**class** · package [`hide.ui`](README.md) · source [`hide_js/hide/ui/View.hx`](https://github.com/Jonathan-HETEAU/hide/blob/ccr-01f70725-tatboj/hide_js/hide/ui/View.hx) · available on editor (js)

A view class is registered with `View.register`.
